### 📚 Life Table Construction

In this activity, we constructed and compared life tables using mortality records from cemeteries in Heredia and San José. The analysis helped us examine differences in survival and mortality patterns between the two populations.

[View Exercise →](cementerio.qmd)

This section presents the geographic distribution of *Pulsatrix perspicillata* in Costa Rica and summarizes occurrence records by province and canton..

## Portfolio Objective

More than a collection of assignments, this portfolio is an organized record of my learning. It documents the procedures, results, and reflections developed throughout the course.

By the end of the semester, this site will showcase the growth of my skills in ecological data analysis, R programming, and scientific communication
